title: Proper and open coefficient identities for the compactification factors
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-sf-datum], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=A_{E,n}$ and $B=A_{E,m}$, $1\le m\le n$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and fix a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{r}Y$, $rj=f$, with $j$ open and $r$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Work in the ordinary constant-ring module derived categories on small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $\rho_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ with its $B$-action. Let $s_{V,W}:\rho(V\otimes_A^LW)\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho V\otimes_B^L\rho W$ and $t_u:\rho Lu_A^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu_B^*\rho$ be the canonical scalar tensor and pullback comparisons [lem-fix-operation-reduction]. Define
$$a^u_{V,W}=(1\otimes t_u)\circ s_{V,Lu_A^*W}:\rho(V\otimes_A^LLu_A^*W)\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho V\otimes_B^LLu_B^*\rho W.$$
Take $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], each equipped with a bounded constructible finite-Tor etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and put $M=j_{!,A}K$ and $H=K\otimes_A^LLf_A^*L$.

Write $\pi_R:Rr_{*,R}M_R\otimes_R^LL_R\to Rr_{*,R}(M_R\otimes_R^LLr_R^*L_R)$ for the counit-defined proper projection and $\gamma_R:j_{!,R}K_R\otimes_R^LLr_R^*L_R\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{!,R}(K_R\otimes_R^LLf_R^*L_R)$ for the canonical open tensor map, including $Lj^*Lr^*\cong Lf^*$, as defined in [def-exchange-projection]. In the reduced proper projection take $M_B=\rho_ZM$; write $K_B=\rho_XK$, $L_B=\rho_YL$, and use the open coefficient comparison $d_V:\rho_Zj_{!,A}V\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{!,B}\rho_XV$ when identifying these proper inputs. Let $c_V:\rho_YRr_{*,A}V\to Rr_{*,B}\rho_ZV$ be the adjunction mate of $t_r$, and let $c_f$ be the canonical compact-support coefficient map [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. Then $c$ is natural, and
$$c_f(V)=Rr_{*,B}(d_V)\circ c_{j_{!,A}V}\quad(V=K,H).$$
The proper and open factor identities, with right-to-left composition, are
$$Rr_{*,B}(a^r_{M,L})\circ c_{M\otimes_A^LLr_A^*L}\circ\rho_Y(\pi_A)=\pi_B\circ(c_M\otimes1)\circ s_{Rr_{*,A}M,L},$$
$$j_{!,B}(a^f_{K,L})\circ d_H\circ\rho_Z(\gamma_A)=\gamma_B\circ(d_K\otimes1)\circ a^r_{M,L}.$$
Both are equalities of the specified maps in the derived categories. No flatness of $B$ over $A$ is assumed; no invertibility of a projection map is asserted.

proof.text: The specified properScalar is a natural transformation obtained by mateEquiv; its naturality field proves the first clause directly. No separate scalar-mate normalization theorem is used.

Apply the proved abstract tensor_mate_coherence calculation to the two geometric adjunctions, the two scalar tensorators, the two restriction tensorators, and lambda. Its required monoidality equation is scalarPullbackTensorCoherence. The conclusion unfolds to the proper factor identity with exactly the counit-defined projections.

Invert the scalar tensor coherence equation and apply the proved generic tensor_square under the two open adjunctions. beta_inverse_aux supplies the common-right-adjoint normalization for the chosen scalar coordinates; the supplied Projection.inverse_adjunct fields fix both projection maps.

Apply the preceding open square to Q=P_A(r)L. Naturality of beta and of the scalar tensorator moves the canonical A compositor through the left route. scalarPullbackCompositionCoherence identifies the combined lambda/compositor map. Naturality of the B projection moves lambda_r to the ambient tensor factor. Functoriality and pair composition give the open factor identity.

The generic scalar_unit_of_counit argument transposes a scalar counit square using adjunction injectivity and the triangle identities. Apply ProperScalarCounitSquare and transport by scalarIso; properScalar_coordinates identifies the chosen geometric mate. Apply OpenScalarCounitSquare and transport through reductionOpenModel and scalarIso to obtain the analogous open scalar-unit equation.

Transpose properScalar followed by direct image of beta under the scalar adjunction. Substitute the proper scalar-unit equation, use naturality of the restriction/direct-image isomorphism, then substitute the open scalar-unit equation. The resulting expression unfolds to compactRestriction after compact support of the scalar unit. Injectivity of the scalar Hom bijection gives compactScalar_factor, applied once to K and once to H.

Uses the existing arbitrary-ring-map normalization of the proper coefficient mate, without invoking its invertibility or any finite-free route.
Scalar-extension/restriction Hom bijection and its actual unit; used to identify B-linear morphisms, not to infer faithfulness of restriction.
